value: Explains why Markdown-in-Git is primary and how the project learned from prior-art failure modes.
Precise as_of validity semantics and explicit ranking limitations make temporal recall unusually rigorous.
Turns session learning into a staged, governed state machine rather than an implicit LLM rewrite.
Documents what was borrowed and what was deliberately not copied from nearby memory systems.
Canonical operational invariants and recovery semantics; unusually comprehensive for a young project.
Clear single-trust-domain boundary and provider/data-export caveats prevent overclaiming.
